What does a BI dashboard provide?: Name the three key features of Power BI listed in the lecture.
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Dashboards, reporting, and online analytical processing (OLAP).

What does a BI dashboard provide?: Which tool do both Excel and Power BI use to extract, transform and load (ETL) data?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: The Power Query Editor.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What engine do Excel's Power Pivot and Power BI's core share?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: VertiPaq, an in-memory, column-based analytical engine.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What expression language do Excel and Power BI both use for calculated columns and measures?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: DAX (Data Analysis Expressions).

What does a BI dashboard provide?: How does the purpose of Excel differ from that of Power BI?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Excel is for spreadsheets and calculation; Power BI is for business intelligence: interactive reports and dashboards.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: How do Excel and Power BI differ in data capacity?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Excel is limited (performance degrades around 1 million rows); Power BI is built for big data.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: How does the data model differ between Excel and Power BI?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: In Excel a data model (Power Pivot) is optional; in Power BI tables and their relationships are mandatory.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: How do Excel and Power BI differ in data refresh and sharing?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Excel refreshes manually and shares files; Power BI refreshes automatically on schedules and shares via the cloud.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What is Business Intelligence (BI)?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: A technology-driven process for analysing data and presenting actionable information.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: List the five steps of the Power BI workflow in order.
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Connect, Transform, Model, Calculate, Visualize & Publish.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: Which Power BI component handles the Connect step?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Power Query: accessing data from sources such as databases, files and web APIs.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: Which component and language handle the Transform step in Power BI?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: The Power Query Editor, using the M language: cleaning, shaping, merging and preparing data (the ETL stage).

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What is done in the Data Model View (the Model step)?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Defining relationships, setting data types, and creating hierarchies.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What is DAX used for in the Power BI workflow (the Calculate step)?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Creating measures (KPIs) and calculated columns for analysis.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: Which components handle the Visualize & Publish step?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Report View and the Power BI Service: building interactive reports and sharing them with end-users.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: Why is a transactional (OLTP) schema a poor basis for BI analysis?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: It is optimized for data entry, not analysis, with many tables and complex joins.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What is the function of OLTP (Online Transactional Processing)?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: To process database transactions and record them.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What are the requirements of an OLTP system?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Real-time, low-latency response; ACID compliance; and high throughput of concurrent transactions.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What is the purpose of OLAP (Online Analytical Processing)?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Interactive data analytics: exploring data to discover interesting findings, with fast responses to each action.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: In a star schema, what is the central table called and what does it record?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: The fact table; it records what happened (e.g. Enrollment).

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What do dimension tables in a star schema provide?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Additional context to the facts: who, what, when, where (e.g. Student, Course, Location).

What does a BI dashboard provide?: How does a snowflake schema differ structurally from a star schema?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Its dimension tables are normalized into child dimension tables.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What is normalization and what are its two aims?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: The systematic organization of columns and tables to minimize data redundancy and improve data integrity.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: Which schema is preferred for OLAP, and why?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: The star schema: fewer joins give faster query performance.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What is the disk-space trade-off between star and snowflake schemas?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Star uses more space (redundancy in dimensions); snowflake is more space-efficient.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: Contrast OLTP and OLAP workloads in terms of users and queries.
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: OLTP: many concurrent users running simple queries that modify a few records; OLAP: few users running complex, usually read-only aggregate queries.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: Is strong (ACID) consistency necessary for OLAP?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: No; OLAP reads from a data warehouse or lake, whereas ACID is very important for OLTP.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What is roll-up (drill-up) in OLAP?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Aggregating data to a higher level, e.g. grades A and B combined into Pass; the reverse of drill-down.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What is drill-down in OLAP?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Breaking data into more detail, e.g. adding a dimension such as sex to a grade count.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What is drill-through in OLAP?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Navigating from a summary view to a detailed report page filtered to a specific context.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What is slicing in OLAP?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Adding filters to focus on particular value(s) of some attribute(s), e.g. only grade A records.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What is the difference between drill-down and slicing?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Drill-down keeps the same data source at finer detail; slicing filters out part of the data.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: Name the techniques that make VertiPaq fast.
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: In-memory columnar storage, compression, multi-threading, and caching.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What is the idea behind an OLAP data cube?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Pre-compute common intermediate results (aggregates over a known feature set $F$) so OLAP actions are answered from the cube.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What assumptions must hold for building a data cube?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: The feature set $F$ is known and small, and its value combinations are far fewer than the database records.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What are the limitations of data cubes?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: A new feature requires recomputing the cube, and new data needs maintenance to update it.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: In SQL terms, what is generating a data cube equivalent to?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: A group-by query over the chosen features, with a count per group.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: Compare VertiPaq and a data cube on flexibility and speed.
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: VertiPaq handles any query with good general speed; a cube is near-instant but only for anticipated queries.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: How can a data cube be integrated with Power BI simply?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Load the cube's cell data instead of the raw data, so Power BI manages far fewer records.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: Where do you import data in Power BI, and what sources were shown?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Home > Get data; databases (e.g. Microsoft SQL) and files (CSV, Excel).

What does a BI dashboard provide?: When an imported CSV's column headers are not recognized, how do you fix it?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: In the Power Query Editor, use the first row as column names.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: Which Power Query feature joins tables, and where is it?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Merge Queries, under Home > Combine > Merge Queries.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What does a Left Anti Join return?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: Records in A that have no match in B.

What does a BI dashboard provide?: What does a Left Outer Join return?
An at-a-glance view of key performance i: All records of A, with matching B values or nulls where there is no match.
